test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Virtious i.e. this word is wrongly spelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **Virtuous**.
 
• **Virtuous**: Morally excellent
 
 
• **Ex**: "**virtuous **and vestal modesty"
 
 
 
• Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's understand the meaning of other given options:

 
• Delicious: Extremely pleasing to the sense of taste
 
• Religious: Concerned with sacred matter
 
• Precious: Characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for
